title: Which City Soulmate Are You?
description: Find your perfect city match based on your personality, lifestyle, and preferences!

tokyo.title: Tokyo, Japan
tokyo.description: You're a vibrant, ambitious soul who thrives in the fast lane. Tokyo matches your energy—efficient, futuristic, and endlessly exciting. You love the blend of tradition and cutting-edge technology.

paris.title: Paris, France
paris.description: You have an artistic, romantic spirit that craves beauty and culture. Paris speaks to your soul with its art, fashion, and café culture. You appreciate the finer things in life.

lisbon.title: Lisbon, Portugal
lisbon.description: You value relaxation, sunshine, and a laid-back vibe. Lisbon matches your love for coastal living, good food, and exploration without the rush. You're effortlessly cool.

newyork.title: New York City, USA
newyork.description: You're ambitious, driven, and love the buzz of city life. NYC is your playground—endless opportunities, diverse people, and energy that never sleeps. You're a true city lover.

reykjavik.title: Reykjavik, Iceland
reykjavik.description: You have a unique, introverted spirit that loves nature and solitude. Reykjavik suits your calm demeanor and appreciation for dramatic landscapes, Northern Lights, and peace.

bangkok.title: Bangkok, Thailand
bangkok.description: You're adventurous, open-minded, and love sensory experiences. Bangkok matches your excitement for street food, vibrant nightlife, and cultural exploration.
